notes.title: Grace of Zordan is even freeer than it was
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831037/442f858bb41cf55810cb6fda6986cbb7562530c1.png[/img]

[h1]Grace of Zordan is even freeer than it was[/h1]

[h2]Hello Dear players![/h2]

For a long time, our small indie team realized that many players like the game, but making cards in it is too difficult.

Recently, any player will be able to use any cards in their decks. We really hope that you will challenge your friends to this game and enjoy the gameplay in all its glory. We believe that there are no more games like [b]Grace of Zordan[/b] in the world.
But this game really needs community support. That is yours!

We love [b]Grace of Zordan[/b] very much. We want you to love her too. ːsteamhappyː

Sincerely, The main developer of the game, elamaunt.

notes.notes:

We published an update to the AI, with which you will now find it more interesting to play.

Dear players, we want to remind you that to run the game you need to have installed on your computer [url=https://www.microsoft.com/ru-ru/download/details.aspx?id=49982].Net framework 4.6.1.[/url] and [url=https://www.microsoft.com/ru-ru/download/details.aspx?id=34429] DirectX 9.0c.[/url].

notes.title: We have returned!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/9bacc7ff00e52d9ff36a29064ef451966260f66d.png[/img]

[h1]Greetings, Dear players, the development team is with you.[/h1]

We apologize for the long absence, we had financial difficulties, but we never forgot about Grace of Zordan.
We remember your impressions of the game and all the suggestions for improving it.

Over time, our team has many ideas that we want to implement in the game.

The most hot and relevant changes we implemented in this update. This includes fixing bugs that did not allow you to get full pleasure from the game in the rating match, as well as improving AI, with which you can play and experiment with the strategy. Yes, now the AI ​​does not have to wait, it goes very fast ;) In the future it will improve.

In order to interest you more, we decided to make a gift to everyone and open [b][u]free cards mode until August 1[/u] [/b]. Now you can take any cards in the game and try to win with them a ranking table. We also worked on the rating system and made it easier and more understandable. Now active players will be easier to move higher and higher on the table.

At the moment, we are more focused on developing game modes for single player. But this does not mean that the multiplayer will not change. Cards have become cheaper, and more bonuses from victories.

Have a good game and see you in the rating matches! Always with you, the development team.


[h1]List of changes (patch 1.1.2.4): [/h1]

The Free-To-Play mode is activated for all cards in the game until August 1 2018. (You can, without making in-game purchases,
use absolutely all game cards).

A new artificial intelligence BasicAI v.0.3
The design was updated.
Reduced the travel time from 120 seconds to 60 seconds.
Now the cards are automatically taken in the order of the decks, and not by accident.
Reduced prices for the legendary cards in 2 times.
Reduced prices for rare cards (from 20% to 35%).
The system of rating awards and penalties has been improved. (Now at least + 10pts for the win
and a maximum of -20pts per defeat for any rating difference).

Fixed zero timer bug in rating game mode.
Fixed a bug in the players' out of sync and loss of game state when the connection to the Internet was poor.
Corrected the situation of incorrect attribution of victory or defeat.

P. S. don't forget to join in our discord: https://discord.gg/AZKjV7f

notes.title: How to get cards in Grace of Zordan?
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/442f858bb41cf55810cb6fda6986cbb7562530c1.png[/img]

[h1]How can I get all the cards without donate?[/h1]

This information will tell you how gold is credited in the game Grace of Zordan.

Once a day for a victory, the player receives [b]50[/b] gold.
If he has [b]0 PTS[/b], for the subsequent [b]4[/b] wins, the player will receive another [b]10[/b] of gold and then for each subsequent victory by [b]1[/b] of gold.

It turns out, for [b]5[/b] victories you can get [b]90[/b] gold per day.
For every [b]50 PTS[/b] you increase the number of awards for [b]10[/b] gold by [b]1[/b], i.e. if you have a [b]450[/b] rating, you will get [b]180[/b] gold for [b]14[/b] victories.

Total: not much gold for [b]1[/b] day. But in the game there is a system of boosters that multiply your rewards for winning the rating matches in [b]2[/b], [b]5[/b], [b]10[/b]. 
With the booster [b]X10[/b] for [b]5[/b] wins in the ranking match you will get [b]900[/b] gold with [b]0 PTS[/b] and [b]1800[/b] gold at [b]450 PTS[/b] for [b]14[/b] victories. Boosters are very profitable, even bought for gold, if you win [b]5[/b] games a day.

Also you get gold for each level increase. For every next level you will receive more and more gold. For the [b]2[/b] level you get [b]205[/b] gold, for [b]9[/b] level you get [b]300[/b] gold, etc. But this gold is not multiplied by a booster for gold.
Also, there are experience boosters in the game that multiply the experience gained in [b]2[/b], [b]5[/b], [b]10[/b] times.
If you buy a booster on the experience for diamonds, it will be profitable even with a little activity, and if for gold, you need to play a lot to pay it back.


[h1]How can I get all the cards with the minimum donat?[/h1]

You need to buy diamonds, buy booster on them gold and experience. Next, sit quietly playing, winning at least [b]5[/b] games a day. You very quickly buy up all the rare cards and can already save on the legendary. As you can see, it is not necessary to spend all your free time in the game. It is enough to be a stably active player. In addition, there will be little expensive cards, we will add not only legendary cards to the game, but also ordinary ones, and rare ones, which will have a small price.

In today's update, [b]the price of boosters on X2 and X5 will be reduced[/b], as we realized that the price is quite high for new players who are trying to accumulate on their first booster.

[b]P.S.[/b] We, as players, test this system on ourselves and try to make it the most correct one. So far, the system works like this, but we constantly think about it. Early access is intended for this purpose.
Perhaps there will be some changes.

notes.title: The time has come
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831037/3d5e49079191a26532b3c806126349afdfecf245.png[/img]

Hello friends!

The moment has come, which we all have been waiting for. We're in early access!
This is a very exciting moment for us, since this is the first time on Steam and for the first time we try ourselves as serious developers.

When entering the game for the first time, do not forget to complete the training. Some of the mechanics of our gameplay may seem unusual to players from different CCG and players who are not familiar with such games. We tried to make the game as competitive as possible, but at the same time flexible and interesting. Do not rush to say that there are not enough game cards in our game. We do not specifically add cards that will not be used by players in a serious game. In other words, we are trying to avoid the appearance of a meta. Therefore, the cards may not seem much, but during the game you may want to change your opinion.

In the game at the moment there is multiplayer and a game with a weak computer opponent. If our game is pleasant to you, we plan to add a campaign to it, new cards and improve the computer opponent. And also a lot of other content. 1v1 game mode has been for us a priority during development. We are in no way going to throw it.

The first weeks from now will be completely spent for fixing bugs, reading your reviews and, of course, playing along with you.

Let's see who deserves the favor of Zordan.
